youtube_description: Few would argue that Eric Clapton remains the greatest blues guitarist Britain ever produced, and one of the most prodigious talents to ever emerge from London during the Swinging Sixties. Interviewed in 1989 for Australian audiences, Eric is disarmingly honest on the rises and falls of his storied career and tells how he finally came to terms with himself and his talent
